title: Jazz Fusion
tagline: Jazz improvisation meeting rock volume, electric instruments, and global rhythms.
summary: Jazz fusion combines jazz improvisation and harmony with elements of rock, funk, and other musical traditions. Electric instruments and amplified ensembles became especially prominent in the late 1960s and 1970s. Fusion remains an open-ended field in which musicians experiment with rhythm, virtuosity, and cross-cultural influences.

pillars.name: Miles Davis
pillars.why: Davis's electric recordings opened a major path for jazz musicians to engage with rock and funk.

pillars.name: Weather Report
pillars.why: Weather Report developed an adventurous ensemble sound that drew on jazz, electronics, and global rhythms.

pillars.name: Mahavishnu Orchestra
pillars.why: The group combined high-energy rock volume with virtuosic jazz improvisation and complex arrangements.
